reason: Bounded representative sensitivity: GCN30 covers max_steps overcompression; GraphSAGE50 covers off-target STOP. Within each model Phase A deploys the same architecture for both targets. Two additional lambda values per representative condition (four runs), rather than automatically expanding to every model/target. Selection is based on stopping/compression mechanisms, not validation quality or test data. No inference to untested model/target/lambda cells and no final research hyperparameter choice.
